content.title:
Phillip Phillips on Instagram: "The cat is out of the bag. Or the dog, rather. My time on @maskedsingerfox as Pugcasso was certainly memorable. The show had a wonderful crew and backstage team. Releasing “Homesick” with the finale felt perfect.

This song bottles up exactly how I felt. We filmed the show last fall when I had a new baby girl and my big boy was starting kindergarten. Getting to do this with my family cheering me on was awesome, especially having them to come home to. Thank you all for coming with me on another journey sprinkled with some TV. Let’s get back to the music. So, so much more to come. #TheMaskedSinger #Pugcasso"
